description_en: Calls the PublishLiveRoom operation to publish a live room, change the live room status to streaming, and obtain the push and pull stream URLs
description_zh: 调用PublishLiveRoom发布直播，将直播状态转变为直播中，并获取推拉流地址
kebab_example: aliyun imp publish-live-room --app-id 7m000q --live-id b7f20000ebb3 --user-id as0000hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishLiveRoom

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. The ID is generated when you create the application in the console. It contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live room
parameters.name: live_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the operator. Only letters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 操作人ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位
parameters.name: user_id
